title: Proof2Hybrid: Automatic Mathematical Benchmark Synthesis for Proof-Centric Problems
abstract: arXiv:2508.02208v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Evaluating the mathematical capability of Large Language Models (LLMs) is a critical yet challenging frontier. Existing benchmarks fall short, particularly for proof-centric problems, as manual creation is unscalable and costly, leaving the true mathematical abilities of LLMs largely unassessed. To overcome these barriers, we propose Proof2Hybrid, the first fully automated framework that synthesizes high-quality, proof-centric benchmarks from natural language mathematical corpora. The key novelty of our solution is Proof2X, a roadmap of converting mathematical proofs into various kinds of questions that are easy to verify. Instructed by this roadmap, we propose a new type of hybrid-formatted questions, named ``$m$-out-of-$n$ multiple judge questions'', specifically designed to enable robust, automatic evaluation while being resilient to guessing and superficial pattern matching inherent in traditional formats. translated_title: Proof2Hybrid：面向证明类问题的自动数学基准合成
translated_abstract: 评估大型语言模型（LLM）的数学能力是一个关键且充满挑战的前沿领域。现有基准测试存在不足，尤其是针对以证明为核心的问题，因为人工创建既难以扩展又成本高昂，导致LLM的真实数学能力在很大程度上未被充分评估。为了克服这些障碍，我们提出了Proof2Hybrid，这是首个从自然语言数学语料库中合成高质量、以证明为核心的基准测试的全自动化框架。我们解决方案的关键创新是Proof2X，这是一条将数学证明转换为多种易于验证的问题类型的路线图。在该路线图的指导下，我们提出了一种新型混合格式问题，称为“$m$选$n$多重判断题”，专门设计用于实现稳健的自动评估，同时能够抵御传统题型中固有的猜测行为和表面模式匹配问题。作为演示……
tldr: 提出了首个全自动化框架Proof2Hybrid，通过Proof2X路线图将数学证明转化为易于验证的新型“m选n多重判断题”，从自然语言数学语料库自动合成高质量证明类基准，实现对大语言模型数学能力的稳健评估。
en_tdlr: Proof2Hybrid is the first fully automated framework that synthesizes high-quality proof-centric math benchmarks from natural language corpora, introducing Proof2X—a roadmap for converting proofs into easily verifiable questions—and a novel "m-out-of-n multiple judge question" format that is robust against guessing and superficial pattern matching.
